items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Barnet had tried to get me, and Joe Glaser asked him for ten thousand dollars for my contract.

ctx.x: Charlie Barnet had tried to get me, and Joe Glaser asked him for ten thousand dollars for my contract. But he was scared of that. I don't blame him, you know. So they knew that. So I had given them the information. So when I went down there to see what he had for me, he started saying, "Well, I can put you in this club here." I said, "Look, I can get those things myself." I said, "You know what? I'm tired of having a band? I've been offered to go with several bands, and I think I might try one of them bands." He…
So I went to the White Rose, and I called him up, and he said, "Well, just hang out a while and don't go back up
